verdict.rationale: OpenCode ships an official JS/TS SDK that provides a type-safe client for building integrations and controlling opencode programmatically against the `opencode serve` headless HTTP server. That server exposes an OpenAPI endpoint, and a probe confirmed a live openapi.json, which also allows generating clients in other languages. Missing for 10: official SDKs beyond JS/TS (the story says SDKs, plural), in-depth SDK reference detail in the evidence, and independent hands-on corroboration of building with the SDK.
